role_summary: Strategic leadership role focused on driving enterprise-wide AI enablement, large-scale automation, and AI-native insurance business models within a regulated environment.
must_have_requirements: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or Actuarial Science
Minimum 15 years professional experience in insurance or financial services
Proven track record of enterprise data and AI transformation at scale
10+ years of experience in data strategy and management
Advanced command of written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese or Mandarin)
Deep understanding of insurance operations (underwriting, claims, actuarial, distribution)
Hands-on experience with production-grade AI delivery and MLOps
Experience operating in highly regulated industry environments
nice_to_have_requirements: Published thought leadership or external speaking experience
Expertise in Agentic AI and autonomous workflow design
Deep technical proficiency with Microsoft 365 Copilot stack
Experience with knowledge graphs and RAG architectures

scoring_criteria.name: Insurance Domain Expertise
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role requires navigation of specific insurance regulatory and operational complexities.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from pure tech sectors without FS exposure

scoring_criteria.name: AI Transformation at Scale
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The business needs to move beyond pilots to production-ready enterprise systems.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates with academic or research-only backgrounds

scoring_criteria.name: Governance & Regulatory Compliance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Responsible AI in insurance is non-negotiable for risk management.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from startups with low regulatory scrutiny

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership & Stakeholder Influence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must drive shift in organizational behavior and influence executive boards.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates focused strictly on implementation rather than strategy

scoring_criteria.name: Enterprise Data Strategy
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Essential for building the data foundation required for mature AI systems.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates focused on software engineering rather than data strategy

scoring_criteria.name: Language Proficiency
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Bilingual requirement (English/Chinese) is critical for local team leadership and stakeholder communication.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Professional experience in Hong Kong/China markets

scoring_criteria.name: Change Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Internal AI enablement relies on organizational culture shifts.

scoring_criteria.name: Academic Credentials
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Sets the baseline for technical depth.

summary_focus: Highlight specific fiscal impact of AI/Data initiatives in insurance settings.
Emphasize experience in moving AI projects from experimentation to institutionalized, production-grade tools.
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim 'full lifecycle AI' if your experience is limited to pilot evaluation or external vendor management.
Be precise about Chinese language capability; strictly outline professional/business fluency.

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Strategic, authoritative, yet collaborative and pragmatic.
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as an 'Enabler'; someone who bridges the gap between complex AI architecture and tangible business value.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If limited in specific insurance domain areas, emphasize transferable experience in highly regulated fintech environments.
If you lack experience with a specific stack, highlight your methodology for learning and deploying new enterprise toolsets.
